# Amendment to plan:nav-home-prefetch (dd9713a6e): idle git launch counts

Reviewer pij-unaware-quokka found an overstatement in the deliverable and in the dd9713a6e commit message. Both said the one-idle-tab window went "158 -> 3". The 3 counts only `git worktree list` launches. Total git launches in that window were **11**. The raw data is unchanged: `/tmp/launches-after.json` and `/tmp/home-prefetch-gitshim-after.log`. The shim logs every git launch with no filter; the preload traces only `worktree list`.

Corrected table (same runs, no re-measurement):

| Window (load) | origin/main 0aebeb1a5 | dd9713a6e resolver code |
|---|---|---|
| Boot | 216 launches (108 list + 108 version) | 55 (54 list + 1 version) |
| Idle, no client, 60 s (125–130) | 0 | 0 |
| One idle tab, 120 s (107–137): all git | 158 | **11** |
| — `worktree list` | 70 | 3 |
| — `--version` | 88 | 0 |
| — `status --porcelain=v1`, `log --name-only`, `diff --name-only`, `diff HEAD` (2 each) | 0 | 8 |

Scope of the fix:
- The change removes the worktree-detection launches: `worktree list` and `--version` went from 158 to 3. The 3 remaining were re-reads after real commits in osk_central and unimatrix.
- It does not touch the other 8 launches (`status`, `log`, `diff`). The preload traced only `worktree list`, so I have no stacks for them and they are unattributed here.
- [INFERENCE] The 8 come from the open browser page's changed-files and diff reads. They do not appear in the origin/main window, plausibly because that server was saturated by its worktree-detection backlog, but I did not prove it.
- "Idle with a tab open launches zero git" is therefore not met by this commit. Whether those reads are in scope is the prime's routing call: item 6/7 trace-idle versus a follow-up here.

The commit message on main (dd9713a6e) carries the same "158 -> 3" wording. It is pushed and cannot be amended; this note is the correction of record.
